name: meterapp-meter
description: Plugins by Meter. Meter: the taxi meter and fleet platform, for AI agents. Ride booking for riders, fleet insights, onboarding, safe settings changes and driver self-service over the hosted MCP server.

plugins.name: meter
plugins.description: Give your agent the signed-in person's view of Meter: book and track your own rides with a preview and your confirmation, plus fleets, trips, bookings, drivers, vehicles, earnings and accounting and confirmable settings changes. Six skills plus the hosted MCP server with OAuth sign-in; no API keys.
